resources.string: Find a passage, inspect its source, and keep your search scope explicit.
Connect Moodle and load the course catalog first.
The saved index could not be read. Reset the local search indexes explicitly; original downloads and AI connection are retained.
The operation could not finish. Check the selected downloads or AI connection and try again.
Build a local index from verified downloads. No AI key is needed for keyword search. One active course index is stored per account.
Local keyword search is available offline. Other courses and unselected documents are excluded.
Coverage is limited. Some text may be clipped or unsupported. PDF extraction has no verified page locator or OCR; inspect the original.
Semantic indexing did not finish. The local keyword index was saved and remains usable.
Delete this account’s passage copies and vectors? Original downloads are retained.
Search runs locally. Try a course code, Vietnamese terms or an exact identifier.
Search sends this query to your configured AI to create its vector. No automatic requests while typing.
Semantic search is unavailable. Showing local BM25 results instead; no generated answer is substituted.
%1$d changed or unavailable documents were removed from this index. Rebuild after reviewing downloads.
Try fewer terms or review the selected documents. A match is a source excerpt, not a verified answer.
Extracted text lines %1$d–%2$d · PDF page unknown
Choose up to %1$d verified downloads. Rebuilding replaces this account’s active course index. The picker shows up to %2$d entries from the loaded course catalog.
Download in the course or Offline downloads first
No course files in the loaded catalog. Open the course and download supported files first.

This sends selected document text to OpenAI and incurs API usage, up to %1$d passages. Notebook outputs and account/download metadata are not added. Search queries are sent separately when you press Search.
Configure a Direct OpenAI connection first. BM25 works without it; the current gateway does not support embeddings.

Chunk size 400–2400 characters; overlap at most one third. k1: 0.1–3; b: 0–1; candidates: 10–100; fusion k: 1–200. Embedding model: text-embedding-3-small/large; dimensions: 128–1024. Changes require rebuilding.
Some parameters are outside the supported ranges.
Reset all account search indexes on this device? Original downloads and AI connection settings are retained.
